title: run-epic/settle now exec `gh auth token` at startup even for repos that declare no close-out rule
body: pullRequestsForRun resolves its credential unconditionally at run start, so after vo4 a machine with gh installed and no GITHUB_TOKEN runs one `gh auth token` subprocess per `ticfac run-epic`/`ticfac settle` even when the target repo declares no PR + CI rule (the result is then discarded with the nil surface). The behavior is correct — it is the price of the ladder — but tick 9sz already plans 'when, and only when, the close-out rule needs a forge': its implementation can read the rule first (reconcile.ReadCloseoutRule) and skip the resolution entirely, or pullRequestsForRun can accept a rule argument.
